label: Four-account table: manifestation selects without contingency; ranges; contingent exercises
paraphrase: Analyst formulation on one finite carrier: four candidate outcomes (total omission none, D-realizing creations c and d, unfit creation z), actual outcome c, two explanatory levels of one source (nature: one cell; exercise: cells following the outcome). Necessary manifestation (scope c only): its nature excludes none, z and d and selects c, and c is not contingent. Invariant D-range source (scope c, d; the matched encoding of an impersonal propensity, of intrinsic generative finality, or of a standing will without a further exercise datum): its nature excludes none and z but not d, does not select, and c is contingent. Invariant permissive source (scope none, c, d): its nature excludes z but not none. Exercise account (scope c, d; the matched encoding of a rational adoption, of a propensity's actualization and of a generative exercise): its exercise level selects c, c is contingent, the exercise level deliberatively sees to its own cell, the nature level does not see to that cell, and the nature level does not exclude d. Permissive exercise (scope none, c, d): the exercise level excludes none, the nature level does not, and the exercise level deliberatively sees to its own cell. These are finite structural surrogates; they type no intellect, apprehension, chance measure or goodness.
